title: Hollow Knight 3D Nails
description: A reskin of 5 Swords (not 7...) to represent the Nails (Weapon) from Hollow Knight!
body:
# Pigifyer Presents: Hollow Knight 3D Nails!

- This is a Resource Pack dedicated to reskin the main 5 Swords to the 5 different Nail Levels from Hollow Knight. I don't know what else to explain that it is a reskin of 5 swords


<details>
<summary>Features</summary>

- Custom Sword 3D Models
- Custom Sword Textures
- Nothing Else!

</details>
